historical_bva_constraint.prohibition: Do not call historical BVA a matched-horizon VA-vs-VAC control and do not overwrite, relabel, or reuse its cache as a +27 cache.

option_a_minimum_matched_target_confirma.purpose: Confirm the already matched B1/B_HVA/B2 fixed-seed result across training seeds without introducing a new model identity.

option_b_full_online_input_by_target_mat.purpose: Estimate both online Contact-State and matched-horizon target effects with a clean no-contact VA control.

new_model_identity.reason: Historical BVA has a different +16-row / 0.32 s target contract.

option_b_full_online_input_by_target_mat.run_accounting: B_VA27 at seeds42/43/44 (3) plus B0/B1/B_HVA/B2 at seeds43/44 (8). Existing seed42 B0/B1/B_HVA/B2 remain frozen.

shared_training_contract_if_separately_a.training_seed_rule: Use the preregistered seeds 43 and 44, selected without observing their outcomes.
shared_training_contract_if_separately_a.initialization: independent exact frozen official pi0.5 base for every new model/seed
shared_training_contract_if_separately_a.target_contract: All VA/VAC target comparisons use episode-local raw/control t-to-t+27 (approximately 0.54 s), the B2 valid-row identity, and no cross-episode transition or future-RGB interpolation.
shared_training_contract_if_separately_a.recipe: same frozen official pi0.5 optimization recipe; final checkpoint only; no rollout-based selection

evaluation_contract_if_separately_author.seed_status: candidate only; must be re-audited and frozen before any evaluation
evaluation_contract_if_separately_author.reset_rule: one preregistered seed8 reset sequence shared across every checkpoint in the selected option
evaluation_contract_if_separately_author.runtime_rule: Preserve the seed42 cohort's evaluator semantics if comparing cohorts. The observed asynchronous retry nondeterminism must be preregistered and disclosed; exact retry policy is fixed before outcomes.
evaluation_contract_if_separately_author.alternative_runtime_rule: A new synchronous deterministic cohort requires rerunning every group in that cohort and separate authorization; it cannot be mixed silently with seed42.

statistical_contract_if_separately_autho.method: report each seed's paired effect, then use a hierarchical bootstrap with training seed as the outer resampling unit or a preregistered hierarchical binary model
statistical_contract_if_separately_autho.prohibition: Do not pool rollout outcomes across training seeds as independent observations.
statistical_contract_if_separately_autho.limitation: Three training seeds still provide a limited estimate of training randomness.

known_runtime_limitation.event: During PI2M B2 recovery, the first 31 completed outcomes from the interrupted attempt agreed with the clean replay on 18 resets and differed on 13, despite identical reset IDs.
known_runtime_limitation.consequence: The asynchronous evaluator is reset-identity reproducible but not bit/outcome deterministic across retries. PI2M used one complete clean 200-reset replay as canonical and did not splice or select per-reset outcomes.
